title: Towards Transfer Unlearning: Empirical Evidence of Cross-Domain Bias Mitigation
findings: The paper found evidence of 'transfer unlearning', where debiasing the model specifically on gender-related hate speech also led to a reduction in religious bias as measured by the CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet benchmarks. This suggests that unlearning one type of bias can have a positive, cross-domain effect on mitigating other biases like those related to religion.
